LENA VARGA-HOLM
Senior Data Engineer

[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Data Engineer with experience designing, building and operating production data platforms and cloud data warehouses. Owns ingestion and orchestration across Airflow, Snowflake, dbt and Kafka, with hands-on experience using Python, SQL and AWS data services. Delivered measurable improvements in pipeline latency, warehouse build times, database load and data-platform costs. Mentors engineers and contributes to open-source data tooling.

CORE SKILLS
Data platform engineering | Python | SQL | Snowflake | AWS | Kafka | Airflow | dbt | Data ingestion and orchestration | Data modelling and transformation | Query and warehouse optimisation | Data quality and testing | CI/CD | Terraform | Great Expectations | PostgreSQL | PySpark | Redshift | GitHub Actions

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. | 2022–Present
- Own ingestion and orchestration for the data platform, using Airflow, Snowflake, dbt and Kafka.
- Participate in the data-platform on-call rotation, one week in six.
- Mentor two mid-level engineers and run data-platform office hours.
- Sized Snowflake warehouses, enabled auto-suspend and removed unused tables; reduced the monthly bill from approximately 38k to 24k in 2024.
- Designed and built a shipment-event streaming pipeline processing around 30 million events per day, with end-to-end latency under two minutes at p95.
- Added a dead-letter topic and replay tooling so failed shipment events can be reprocessed without data loss.
- Replaced hourly full-table extracts from the orders database with Debezium CDC into Kafka, reducing replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%.
- Migrated approximately 300 stored procedures into dbt models with tests and documentation; introduced incremental models and slim CI using state:modified in GitHub Actions.
- Reduced the nightly warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes and made data lineage visible to analysts.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay | 2019–2022
- Built PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR and designed Redshift warehouse solutions.
- Worked on data quality using Great Expectations.
- Built a transaction reconciliation engine matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers using PySpark on EMR.
- Reduced the finance team's manual reconciliation work from approximately three days to four hours per month-end.

SELECTED OPEN-SOURCE CONTRIBUTION
Airflow provider package fixes | 2023
- Fixed a pagination bug and added tests for a community Airflow provider for a SaaS CRM API; two pull requests were merged.
- Technologies: Python, Airflow, pytest.

EDUCATION
MSc, Computer Science | Northgate Technical University
Thesis: Incremental materialized views

CERTIFICATION
AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate | May 2024

COMMUNITY & SPEAKING
- Teach beginner SQL at a local women-in-tech meetup, approximately four evenings per year since 2021.
- Presented “Data contracts without the hype” at a regional data meetup in 2024.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured senior-level CV with clear section headings, concise bullets, credible technical scope, and excellent quantified outcomes. The strongest evidence includes processing approximately 30 million events per day, reducing the Snowflake bill from approximately 38k to 24k per month, reducing replica CPU from approximately 70% to 25%, and shortening the warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes. Ownership, operational responsibility, mentoring, open-source contribution, and business impact are all communicated effectively. The main content concerns are the unresolved employment-history inconsistency in the source material and the use of contact placeholders.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses conventional ATS-friendly headings, a simple text layout, standard date formatting, and relevant keywords such as Python, SQL, Snowflake, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, CI/CD, Terraform, Great Expectations, PostgreSQL, PySpark, and Redshift. Its likely ATS screening probability is high for the platform engineering aspects of the role. Keyword coverage could be improved by explicitly naming supported AWS services and technologies from the portfolio, including AWS EMR, AWS MSK, S3, Glue Data Catalog, Kafka Connect, Snowpipe Streaming, and Debezium. The placeholders '[EMAIL]', '[PHONE]' and '[LINKEDIN]' must be replaced before submission because they can reduce parsing quality and make the CV appear unfinished.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns very well with production data platform ownership, cloud data warehousing, orchestration, streaming, data quality, operational support, performance optimisation, open-source practices, and mentoring. It also demonstrates the company's ownership, teamwork, and pace signals through on-call responsibility, mentoring, office hours, open-source fixes, and quantified efficiency improvements. AWS is a credible comparable-cloud match through Snowflake, Redshift, EMR, and other AWS data services. The candidate material does not establish dimensional modelling, so that requirement is a genuine gap rather than a wording problem. Graph modelling and Portuguese are also gaps based on the supplied material. The document demonstrates good professional English. There is limited explicit evidence of partnering with data scientists, product teams, or enforcing governance and access policies, although work with analysts, data quality, and platform ownership is shown.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL:
1. In the contact line beneath the name, replace '[EMAIL]', '[PHONE]' and '[LINKEDIN]' with the candidate's actual professional contact details and LinkedIn URL. Remove the square-bracket placeholders before submission.
2. Verify the employment history and dates against the authoritative record. The supplied original cover letter names Adria Retail Group as the employer for the previous two years, while the candidate notes and portfolio support Kovalent Pay from 2019–2022 and Lukovac Freight Hub from 2022–Present. In the Professional Experience section, retain only the companies and dates that are factually correct; do not submit the current history until this inconsistency is resolved.

MINOR, HIGH-VALUE ATS ENHANCEMENTS:
3. In the Senior Data Engineer section at Lukovac Freight Hub, expand the streaming-pipeline bullet with supported technologies: change the end of the bullet to include 'using Kafka Connect, Snowpipe Streaming, Python, Terraform and AWS MSK' if those technologies were part of the described project. This makes the comparable-cloud and platform-engineering evidence more searchable without adding unsupported experience.
4. In the Data Engineer section at Kovalent Pay, change 'Built PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR and designed Redshift warehouse solutions.' to 'Built PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR using S3 and Glue Data Catalog, and designed Redshift warehouse solutions.' These services are supported by the candidate portfolio and improve alignment with the cloud requirement.
5. In the Core Skills section, replace the generic 'AWS' entry with supported specific terms such as 'AWS EMR | AWS MSK | S3 | Glue Data Catalog' while retaining 'AWS' if desired. Do not add Google Cloud, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Docker, or Kubernetes because the supplied candidate material does not establish hands-on experience with them.
critique.critical_issues:
1. The contact details are still placeholders: '[EMAIL]', '[PHONE]' and '[LINKEDIN]'. This makes the CV incomplete and may impair recruiter contact and ATS parsing. Fix: replace all placeholders with the candidate's real professional contact information.
2. The supplied source material contains a potential employment-history inconsistency: the original cover letter states employment at Adria Retail Group for the previous two years, whereas the CV and candidate notes state Kovalent Pay from 2019–2022 and Lukovac Freight Hub from 2022–Present. Fix: verify the authoritative employers and dates, then update the Professional Experience section so the submitted CV contains only the correct history.

critique.content_quality_feedback: The CV is clean, concise, professional, and easy to scan. The summary is well targeted to senior data-platform work, and the skills section contains many relevant technologies. The certification, open-source contribution, mentoring reference, and quantified outcomes strengthen credibility. However, the document omits the candidate's two principal employment entries and nearly all of the strongest project evidence from the original candidate information. As a result, it reads more like a profile or selected highlights page than a complete senior-level CV. The absence of employment dates, company names, responsibilities, scale, and quantified achievements substantially weakens completeness and recruiter confidence.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The formatting is ATS-friendly: standard section headings, plain text structure, conventional chronology-independent sections, and no apparent tables, columns, graphics, or parsing barriers. Keyword coverage is good for Python, SQL, Snowflake, AWS, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, CI/CD, Terraform, data quality, and orchestration. AI screening probability is currently moderate rather than high because the CV does not include the Experience section or the portfolio evidence that proves senior-level ownership, scale, query and warehouse optimisation, CDC, dimensional/data modelling, and production operations. The exact terms "production data platform," "query optimisation," "data modelling," "managed warehouse," and "data quality standards" should be used where the candidate's evidence supports them. The current skills list also contains several keywords without associated evidence in the body, which reduces credibility even though they are supported by the candidate information.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document aligns strongly with production data-platform engineering, cloud warehouses, Python/SQL, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, AWS, open-source practices, mentoring, and measurable platform improvements. The strongest matching evidence is not currently visible: a 30-million-events-per-day Kafka pipeline with sub-two-minute p95 latency, a dbt migration that reduced warehouse build time from 5h10 to 1h35, CDC that reduced replica CPU from approximately 70% to 25%, and warehouse optimisation that reduced Snowflake cost from approximately $38,000 to $24,000 per month. The candidate material also supports the role's ownership and collaborative signals through platform ownership, mentoring, office hours, and open-source contribution. Dimensional modelling, graph modelling, Portuguese, and Google Cloud specifically are not established in the candidate material. AWS is a credible comparable cloud for the requirement, particularly through Snowflake, EMR, S3, Redshift, and managed Kafka, but the CV should explain that experience through achievement bullets rather than only listing services.

CRITICAL — In the CV, add a conventional "PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE" section immediately after the Professional Summary and before Core Skills. Add these two roles with dates and evidence from the candidate information:

Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. | 2022–Present
- Own ingestion and orchestration for a production data platform using Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, and Kafka.
- Designed and built a Kafka streaming pipeline processing approximately 30 million shipment events per day, achieving end-to-end latency below 2 minutes at p95 using Kafka Connect, Snowpipe Streaming, Python, Terraform, and AWS MSK.
- Replaced hourly full-table extracts with Debezium CDC from PostgreSQL into Kafka, reducing replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%.

- Mentor two mid-level engineers and run data-platform office hours.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay | 2019–2022
- Designed and maintained Redshift warehouse solutions and PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR for transaction reconciliation.
- Built a reconciliation engine matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers, reducing finance-team manual work from approximately 3 days to 4 hours per month-end.
- Used S3, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift, and Great Expectations for batch data processing and data-quality validation.

CRITICAL — In the Professional Experience section under Lukovac Freight Hub, explicitly include the production scale and operational ownership above. This is necessary to substantiate the job's requirement for designing, building, and operating production data platforms at scale; the current summary alone does not provide sufficient evidence.

CRITICAL — In the Professional Experience section, add the Snowflake cost-reduction achievement and warehouse-build-time achievement exactly or with equivalent quantified wording. These are the candidate's strongest evidence for query/warehouse optimisation and measurable platform impact, but they are currently absent from the CV.

CRITICAL — In the Core Skills section, change "Query and warehouse optimisation" to "Query and warehouse optimisation at scale" only if the accompanying Experience bullets contain the Snowflake cost and warehouse-build results above. Also add "Change data capture (CDC)" and "Debezium," because both are supported by the candidate's portfolio and are relevant to production ingestion-platform work.
